species.real: Starlings have more than halved in the UK since the 1970s, so for all those murmurations they are on the red list of birds of conservation concern.
species.name: Starlet

dex.text: A flock of one that acts like a crowd. Chatters with everyone it meets, mostly copying whatever it heard last.
dex.fact: A starling murmuration can contain thousands of birds, and each bird keeps track of about seven neighbours.

species.real: About a hundred starlings were let loose in New York's Central Park around 1890, and their descendants across North America now number in the tens of millions.
species.name: Murmurant

dex.text: A thousand small birds that somehow behave as one. Politely declines to explain how it works, which is fair, since nobody else can either.
dex.fact: Starlings can copy other sounds, including car alarms and mobile phone ringtones.
